name: 8316-imageprefill-qwen2vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=8, bounded at 2048 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% and cooldown the last 10% by completion.
workload: Single-image visual question answering: one fresh 1280x720 jpeg and an 8-token question per request, 20 tokens out, so ~1207 prompt tokens of which 1196 are vision. Every image and every question is distinct. The `image_placeholder` in scenario.json is this checkpoint's own vision markup and is required -- the engine's generic `<image>` default is not found on this model.
purpose: A visual question answering service handling one high-resolution photo and a short question per request, eight concurrent users, single GPU.
